sources.title: AI Detector - Accurate AI Checker for ChatGPT, GPT-5 & Gemini - Smodin
sources.snippet: An AI detector (also known as an AI content detector or AI checker) is a tool that analyzes written material to identify AI-generated content. Smodin AI Detector evaluates scientific papers, documents, marketing content, articles, and essays - detecting text generated by ChatGPT, GPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI models.
